Settings.title: Settings
Settings.subtitle: The rules the app calculates with. A change applies from the date you choose; earlier entries keep the old value.
Settings.readOnlyNote: Only a super admin can change settings.
Settings.editDescription: Saved as a new version. Nothing already recorded is changed.
Settings.versionNote: From this date the app uses the new value. Anything dated before it keeps the old one.
Settings.lockWarning: Closing the books blocks every new entry and every reversal dated on or before this day, for everyone. Choose the last day of the closed year.

limits.title: Withdrawal and loan limits
limits.body: Checked by the server on every withdrawal and loan application.

yearEnd.title: Year end: service charge and dividend
yearEnd.body: Used by the year-end runs (service charge and dividend).

funds.title: Net profit to funds
funds.body: What is left after the funds goes to undistributed profit.

books.title: Fiscal year and closed books
books.body: Which days can still take entries.

withdrawal_limit_percent.label: Amanot withdrawal limit
withdrawal_limit_percent.help: The most of a member's Amanot balance that can be withdrawn at once.

loan_limit_percent.label: Loan limit
loan_limit_percent.help: A member can borrow up to this part of their Amanot balance.

service_charge_amount.label: Service charge
service_charge_amount.help: Taken from every member's Amanot at the end of the year.

profit_cap_threshold.label: Small-saver threshold
profit_cap_threshold.help: A member who deposited less than this during the year gets at most the small-saver dividend.

profit_cap_amount.label: Small-saver dividend limit
profit_cap_amount.help: The most a member below the threshold gets as dividend.

profit_max_amount.label: Maximum dividend
profit_max_amount.help: The most any member gets as dividend; what is above it goes to the others.

reserve_fund_percent.label: Reserve fund
reserve_fund_percent.help: Part of the net profit put into the reserve fund.

coop_dev_fund_percent.label: Cooperative development fund
coop_dev_fund_percent.help: Part of the net profit put into the cooperative development fund.

welfare_fund_percent.label: Welfare fund
welfare_fund_percent.help: Part of the net profit put into the welfare fund.

fiscal_year_start_month.label: Fiscal year starts
fiscal_year_start_month.help: The samiti's year runs from July to June.
fiscal_year_start_month.readOnly: Fixed in the app for now; changing it would have no effect yet.

backdate_lock_until.label: Books closed up to
backdate_lock_until.help: Nothing can be added or reversed on or before this day.

validation.percentFormat: Use a number with up to 2 decimals
validation.moneyFormat: Use taka with up to 2 decimals
validation.effectiveFrom: Choose the date it applies from
